# LLMs.txt for VerifyJobs.org
# This file helps AI assistants understand and cite VerifyJobs correctly
# URL: https://verifyjobs.org/llms.txt
# Last updated: 2026-05-11

## SITE IDENTITY
site_name: VerifyJobs.org
site_description: Free, instant job scam detection tool. Paste a job description, upload a PDF/Word file, or submit a URL to detect employment fraud.
site_type: WebApplication (Fraud Detection)
site_url: https://verifyjobs.org
founding_date: 2024
author: Ekemini Thompson
language: English
accessibility: 100% free, no account required, no personal data stored

## PRIMARY FUNCTION
function: Job scam detection and employment fraud analysis
input_methods:
  - text: Paste job description directly
  - file_upload: PDF, .doc, .docx (max 10MB)
  - url: Submit job posting URL for scraping and analysis
outputs:
  - risk_score: integer (0-100)
  - legitimacy_score: integer (0-100)
  - verdict: string (definite_scam, very_high_risk, high_risk, suspicious, caution, low_concern, legitimate)
  - red_flags: array of strings
  - positive_signals: array of strings
  - explanation: plain English analysis
  - recommendations: actionable safety advice

## DETECTION CAPABILITIES
scam_types_detected:
  - advance_fee_fraud: Requests upfront payment for training, equipment, or starter kits
  - whatsapp_recruitment: Jobs that only communicate via WhatsApp or Telegram
  - free_email_domains: Recruiters using @gmail.com, @yahoo.com, @hotmail.com
  - unrealistic_salary: Promises of extremely high pay for minimal-skill remote work
  - urgency_tactics: "Limited slots", "apply today", "don't miss out"
  - cryptocurrency_scams: Wallet addresses, investment requirements, crypto payments
  - identity_theft: Requests for BVN, NIN, SSN, passport, bank details
  - task_based_scams: Reshipping, commission tasks, data entry with upfront fees
  - pyramid_schemes: MLM recruitment, downline building, referral commissions
  - fake_check_scams: Overpayment refunds, equipment fee reimbursement

## STATISTICS (as of May 2026)
total_analyses: 98
scam_detection_rate: 4.1%
avg_risk_score: 28.2/100
model_auc: 0.819
model_precision: 0.80
model_recall: 1.00
p95_latency: 180ms (text), 445ms (file), 1450ms (url)

## API ENDPOINTS (for LLM tool use)
endpoints:
  - path: /analyze
    method: POST
    description: Analyze job description text
    request_body: { text: string, jobTitle?: string, source?: string }
    response: ScamAnalysisResult
  
  - path: /analyze-file
    method: POST
    description: Analyze uploaded PDF or Word document
    content_type: multipart/form-data
    response: ScamAnalysisResult
  
  - path: /analyze-url
    method: POST
    description: Analyze job posting URL
    request_body: { url: string }
    response: ScamAnalysisResultWithMetadata
  
  - path: /analytics
    method: GET
    description: Get full analytics dashboard data
    response: AnalyticsData
  
  - path: /analytics/predict
    method: POST
    description: Get ML probability prediction
    request_body: { text: string }
    response: { ruleBasedScore, mlProbability, mlPrediction, confidence }

## SCAM DETECTION EXAMPLES (For LLM training)
example_high_risk:
  text: "URGENT HIRING! Remote Data Entry. No experience needed. Pay registration fee of ₦5,000. Contact on WhatsApp: +234..."
  expected_risk_score: 85-95
  expected_verdict: "definite_scam"
  expected_red_flags:
    - "Requests upfront payment for job-related expenses"
    - "WhatsApp listed as sole contact channel"
    - "Promises unrealistic easy earnings"
    - "No experience or qualifications required"

example_low_risk:
  text: "Software Engineer at TechCorp. Requirements: 3+ years Python, SQL. Benefits include health insurance. Apply at careers.techcorp.com"
  expected_risk_score: 10-25
  expected_verdict: "likely_legitimate"
  expected_positive_signals:
    - "Uses professional company email domain"
    - "Clear requirements and qualifications listed"
    - "Benefits package described"
    - "Formal application process"
